method: Qualitative before/after comparison. Before is the placeholder-based V2 baseline at origin/main (merge 31b5d71a3a27acc201b771843b7af8d72cda1d01). After is the same public companies re-run through the deterministic extraction runner. The after side is intentionally more conservative than the first phase-2 revision: a field is populated only when the consumed body supplies text of that field's type (customer names from explicit customer/case-study context, connectors from explicit integration context, pricing plans from a recognized plan name paired with an observed amount), and anything ambiguous stays an explicit unknown instead of a mis-typed claim. Improvements list only real changes; fields that became unknown under the stricter typing are called out rather than counted as gains. Both runs use the same bounded 8/12 page budget, attribution, read-only surfaces, and host_agent synthesis contract.
stripe_headline: Stripe now returns real financial-infrastructure positioning, product/capability names, case-study customer examples, and grounded pricing (Standard plan fee) instead of generic placeholders; integrations stay an explicit unknown because the consumed partners page exposes no clean connector name.
